text_block_list.text: "No matter the obstacles in the way, there was a moment they had to witness. Yes, and that was—"

The moment a brilliant Umamusume who poured everything
into her dreams becomes a new Triple Crown Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Neo Universe!!
Surpassing the wall of the pack, the wall of the storm, and today,
the wall of distance, she finally achieves the Triple Crown!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: Unlike any Triple Crown Umamusume before her, a champion of intellect is born right here, right now!!

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
""MISM"... Unable to achieve...
Causing "disappointment" by failing to achieve..."

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Yet today...
It feels so... sfira...

"Rather than jubilation, Neo Universe's
expression seemed somewhat relieved."

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: Trainer...

"No more words were needed.
Both knew full well the hardships
it had taken to reach this point."

"Neo Universe's azure eyes spoke volumes.
Just then—"
Congratulations to both of you.

"There were Umamusume who had come to offer their congratulations.
Among them were..."

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
You're quite the honor student.
A textbook running style. And yet—

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
"Seeing that through to the end takes incredible passion.
That was a race I could never pull off."

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: Mr. C.B....

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: An honor student... or rather, she seemed quick on her feet. Always observing her surroundings before deciding how to carry herself...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Aligning our wills rather than forcing one's own upon another.
I've learned a valuable lesson as well.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
She was simply—strong. That's all.
Strong enough that I'd love to spar with her someday.

And Narita Brian.
Receiving the congratulations from previous Triple Crown Umamusume...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Neo Universe became――"L4."
A grouping……of the "unknown"……

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: From now on... we "coexist," right?

As a new Triple Crown Umamusume,
Neo Universe vowed to shoulder
her share of the responsibility.
And that night—

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"Trainer, Neo Universe is 'concerned'.
About the Trainer's qualifications......"

I reported that "it was somehow resolved."
Emphasizing that there was no ill intent involved...

Following the correction, no further action was taken.
It seems the URA showed a bit of leniency as well.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Yes...
Then the "interstellar space" is—cleared.

Having overcome major trouble together,
I feel our bond has grown even stronger. At this rate—

It seems she'll be able to challenge her "GATE," the Tenno Sho (Spring),
without hesitation.
However, there is still quite a long time before the race.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: Trainer, Neo Universe is......

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
――?
Prior to acoustic wave generation... "Connect"...

Telepathy. I felt Neo Universe's desire
to run somewhere before the Tenno Sho (Spring).
And as for candidate races for the next run...

From what I saw in today's run,
Long distances seem to put quite a heavy toll on her.
In that case...
It would be best to have her gain experience against Senior Class Umamusume in the 'Japan Cup', which is right on the edge of medium distance.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
—Affirmative. Neo Universe concurs.
On the "Japan Cup".

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"And once we 'observe'
the end of that race—"

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: Neo Universe――wants to share next year's forecast.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: Yes, about "GATE"—and what lies beyond it.

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"I want to talk about
Neo Universe after the "GATE"."

...It seemed a momentous "future prediction"
was about to be revealed after the Japan Cup.
